# elements

`elements` is a R package containing correlative, realised Ecological
Niche Models (ENMs) for the most prevalent vascular plants, bryophytes,
and terricolous lichens in the European Vegetation Archive (EVA) (Chytrý
et al., 2016).

The code used to produce the models is available here
<https://github.com/NERC-CEH/elementsAnalysis>.

## Methods

The ENMs adhere to Hutchinsonian conceptualisation of the ecological
niche as an n-dimensional hypervolume (Hutchinson, 1957). The
environmental variables forming the dimensions of each hypervolume
consist of:

- Seven unweighted, plot-mean Ecological Indicator Values (EIVs):
  - **M** - Soil Moisture¹
  - **R** - Reaction¹
  - **N** - Soil Nitrogen¹
  - **L** - Light¹
  - **GP** - Grazing Pressure²
  - **SD** - Soil Disturbance²
  - **S** - Salinity³
- Four bioclimatic variables:
  - **tmin_wt** - Minimum Winter Temperature⁴
  - **tmax_sm** - Maximum Summer Temperature⁴
  - **prec_wt** - Winter Precipitation⁴
  - **prec_sm** - Summer Precipitation⁴

Support Vector Machine (SVM) models, which form a hyperplane between the
presence and absence hypervolumes, were trained and tested using using
the `mlr3` ecosystem of R packages (Lang et al., 2019). The raw `e1071`
(Meyer et al., 2024) SVM models are bundled in `elements`.

For more information please see Marshall et al (in prep).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

¹(Dengler et al., 2023), ²(Midolo et al., 2023), ³(Tichy et al., 2023),
⁴(Marchi et al., 2020)

## Models

At present there are 8897 ENMs currently included in `elements`.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ALEData`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/ALEData.md)
  : ALE data
- [`calc_distance()`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/calc_distance.md)
  : Calculate the euclidean distance between a set of environmental
  predictor variables and mutliple taxa
- [`calc_distance_once()`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/calc_distance_once.md)
  : Calculate the euclidean distance between one set of environmental
  predictor variables and mutliple taxa
- [`calc_overlap()`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/calc_overlap.md)
  : Calculate the niche overlap between a set of taxa
- [`envelope_filter()`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/envelope_filter.md)
  : Apply an envelope model for a set of predictors for multiple taxa
- [`envelope_filter_taxon()`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/envelope_filter_taxon.md)
  : Apply an envelope model for a set of predictors for one taxon
- [`env_filter()`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/env_filter.md)
  : Retrieve the most suitable taxa for a given set of environmental
  variable values
- [`EUNISConstantTaxa`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/EUNISConstantTaxa.md)
  : EUNISConstantTaxa
- [`EUNISDiagnosticTaxa`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/EUNISDiagnosticTaxa.md)
  : EUNISDiagnosticTaxa
- [`EUNISDominantTaxa`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/EUNISDominantTaxa.md)
  : EUNISDominantTaxa
- [`ExampleData1`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/ExampleData1.md)
  : Example predictor data
- [`ExampleData2`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/ExampleData2.md)
  : Example predictor data
- [`ExamplePlots`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/ExamplePlots.md)
  : A set of example vegetation plots
- [`ExampleScenarios`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/ExampleScenarios.md)
  : Predictor data for three example scenarios
- [`extract_svs()`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/extract_svs.md)
  : Extract the support vectors from an SVM model
- [`Gradients`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/Gradients.md)
  : Univariate gradient intervals for each environmental variable
- [`HOAData`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/HOAData.md)
  : HOA data
- [`Imbalances`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/Imbalances.md)
  : Presence-Absence Imbalances
- [`MaximumProbabilities`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/MaximumProbabilities.md)
  : Maximum Probabilities
- [`ModelledTaxaCodes`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/ModelledTaxaCodes.md)
  : Taxon codes for taxa with models
- [`ModellingTaxaLookup`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/ModellingTaxaLookup.md)
  : Modelling Taxa Lookup
- [`ModelObjectAvailability`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/ModelObjectAvailability.md)
  : Model Object Availability
- [`NicheWidths`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/NicheWidths.md)
  : Niche width data
- [`PDPData`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/PDPData.md)
  : PDP data
- [`PerformanceMeasures`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/PerformanceMeasures.md)
  : Model performance measures
- [`plot_be()`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/plot_be.md)
  : Plot the bivariate effects for a taxon
- [`plot_me()`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/plot_me.md)
  : Plot the marginal effect values for one or more taxa and set of
  variables
- [`predict_occ()`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/predict_occ.md)
  : Generate predictions for the probability of occurrence for specified
  taxa
- [`predict_occ_taxon()`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/predict_occ_taxon.md)
  : Generate predictions for the probability of occurrence
- [`shutdown()`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/shutdown.md)
  : Remove the filehash database connection from the global environment
- [`startup()`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/startup.md)
  : Initiliase a connection to the filehash database containing the
  Ecological Niche Models (ENMs)
- [`TaxonomicBackbone`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/TaxonomicBackbone.md)
  : Taxonomic backbone
- [`VariableData`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/VariableData.md)
  : Environmental indicator value data
- [`VariableNames`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/VariableNames.md)
  : Model variables codes
- [`VariableNamesLookup`](https://NERC-CEH.github.io/elements/reference/VariableNamesLookup.md)
  : Environmental variable names and codes
